name: Sisyphus Necklace – lava stone
fit_note: Very likely the one from your Instagram ads: a tiny silver man pushing a black stone. It's Sisyphus, not Atlas. Small and playful rather than old-money. Chain included, EU shop.

name: Sisyphus Pendant
fit_note: The same myth as a classic oval medal: Sisyphus and his boulder in relief, oxidised silver. Much closer to your old-money style than the figure. €126.95 pendant only. Free express shipping; ships from outside the EU, so check duties.

name: Big Sisyphus Necklace
fit_note: Bigger version with a polished silver-tone ball. Note the pendant is brass, only the chain is sterling.

name: Amor Fati Pendant
fit_note: "Love your fate" engraved on the back. The Stoic answer to Sisyphus: embrace the climb. A rugged little tag, very masculine. Layers well with their Sisyphus medal (15% off the second piece).

name: Plato's Cave Pendant
fit_note: Leaving the cave of shadows to see the world for yourself. Fits your "be yourself, not the creation of others" and building your own worldview.

name: Owl of Athena Coin
fit_note: A replica of the ancient Athenian silver coin: the owl of wisdom. For the reader building a worldview book by book. The most classic, old-money coin on this page.

name: Heraclitus River Pendant
fit_note: "No man steps in the same river twice, for he is not the same man." A man standing in a river: growth and becoming someone new.

name: Memento Mori Pendant
fit_note: "Remember you will die": live like the rally drivers in your notes, and be someone worth bringing back. Strong meaning, but the skull reads darker than your style.

name: Walk The Walk Necklace
fit_note: A figure walking forward in stages. Do, don't just talk: the builder. Same playful style as their Sisyphus.

name: Atlas Necklace – Titan carrying the globe
fit_note: Literal Atlas: the kneeling Titan holding the sphere, inside a Greek-key border. Take polished, 20 mm. Free engraving on the back (up to 15 characters, so "DISCIPLINA" fits). EU, no duties. New shop, photos look like renders.

name: Atlas Medallion – Greek Titan
fit_note: Finely engraved Atlas under the celestial sphere, real photos. A bit busier than the ZakaSchmuck coin. Choose the 925 silver option. From Türkiye, EU customs may apply.

name: ATLAS – Shattuckite & Silver
fit_note: A tiny 3D Atlas figure carrying a blue stone world, like the Farnese statue. The most literal "holding the world", more sculptural than a coin. From Australia, so expect Portuguese VAT on delivery.

name: Pools of Light Armillary Orbital Necklace
colour: Sterling silver, small clear quartz sphere
fit_note: Armillary sphere: three silver rings turning around a small crystal world. What Atlas carries, and the emblem on Portugal's flag. The most refined and abstract piece here. €247.67 at 51 cm. Handmade in the US, 1 left, import VAT likely.

name: 3D Kinetic Armillary Sphere Pendant
fit_note: A true 3D armillary with four nested rings that turn freely. Sculptural, a statement piece. Pendant only at this price. Handmade in the US, 1 left, import VAT likely.

name: Globe Pendant – World Map Disc
fit_note: Clean polished coin with the globe and its lines engraved, a quiet "world map" medal. Free engraving on the back. €137.09 with a 45 cm chain (€103.46 pendant only). EU customs may apply.

name: Coin 01 Large – engraved
fit_note: The minimalist route: a plain coin with "ATLAS" (up to 8 characters) engraved on the back, so only you know. Same brand as your bracelet. €170 coin + €100 chain. Engraved pieces can't be returned.

name: Atlas Open Pendant
fit_note: Possibly the "Atlas" you saw: Tiffany's Atlas line, named after the Titan clock on their New York store. It's a ring of Roman numerals, not the Titan. Pre-owned, the 41 cm chain is short for you, and it's sold as women's.

name: Atlas – rotating world pendant
fit_note: Possibly the "Atlas" chain you saw, as Trendhim advertises a lot on Instagram. Steel, big (35 mm) and heavy, so not my pick, but here so you can compare.
